global: This file is NOT the byte-comparison artefact. The faithful file named in arrayprobe_source_file is: it carries zero attributes because the MATLAB that defines its format writes zero attributes (combine_sizedist.m:202-231, measured), and every validated-flight comparison is made against it. This file holds the same values and adds metadata; use it to read the data, use the faithful file to compare bytes.

Time Vector is a MATLAB datenum in days (combine_sizedist.m:95-120), not the HHMMSS the sd files carry. Seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z = (Time Vector - arrayprobe_datenum_unix_epoch_days) * 86400.

Missing seconds are IEEE-754 NaN in the float64 payload, with no _FillValue attribute -- the faithful writer's own convention (combine_sizedist.m:124-148 pads the 1 Hz grid with NaN; arrayprobe.combine:245-250). No _FillValue is added here, because adding one would change what a masking reader returns.

none by construction when the producer is the port: 'the port is the faithful reproduction and nothing else' (the package's rule that enhancements live outside the port), enforced by tests/test_no_enhancement_coupling.py. scripts/run_flight.py applies corrections only to SEPARATE <stem>.enh.* products (named in their own .call), never to the faithful file this export reads. A non-port chain must name what it applied through this exporter's `enhancements` argument.

absent: the source carries no .tasqc.json, either because the run named no TAS source (probe housekeeping TAS throughout) or because it predates the record (2026-09-23). Which seconds took a default TAS is not established here.

Lossless: every value, dtype and dimension order is the faithful file's, so a chunk can be read over a network without the rest.
